security_finding_pilot_scope_not_enforce.finding: CONTROLLED_PILOT_ENABLED was unset on the live Render deployment. Per ControlledPilotScopeMiddleware's own docstring, when this is false only the existing billing/trust kill switches apply - and BILLING_SELF_SERVE_ENABLED/TRUST_ACCOUNTING_ENABLED both default to true when unset, not false. Practical effect before the fix: none of the pilot-scope restrictions (billing, trust accounting, clients, matters, invoices, signatures, freeform contract creation, upload review, DPA review packs, workflow-template builder, approval-rule authoring) were enforced on the live deployment.
security_finding_pilot_scope_not_enforce.exposure_window: unknown start; found and fixed 2026-08-08. Only the sponsor had used the deployment (self-reported), so no known real-user exposure occurred, but the deployment was already declared the intended pilot go-live.
security_finding_pilot_scope_not_enforce.fix: CONTROLLED_PILOT_ENABLED=true, BILLING_SELF_SERVE_ENABLED=false, TRUST_ACCOUNTING_ENABLED=false, GEMINI_AI_ENABLED=false set on the Render web service
security_finding_pilot_scope_not_enforce.verification: not independently verified by this task - sponsor confirmed the site continued loading correctly after the change; a direct check (e.g. that /contracts/billing/ now redirects) was recommended but not confirmed back to this task in those exact terms

migration_leaf_node_incident.what_happened: PR #115 (canonical NDA runtime) and PR #162 (authenticator app MFA) each independently branched a new Django migration off the same parent (0115_exception_correlation_id). Once both were merged to main by this task, the live Render deploy failed with Django's 'Conflicting migrations detected; multiple leaf nodes' error.
migration_leaf_node_incident.root_cause: this repository's CI evaluates each PR against its own branch, not against the combined graph produced once two independently-developed migrations are both merged - this specific class of conflict is not caught by per-PR CI
migration_leaf_node_incident.fix: a standard empty Django merge migration (contracts/migrations/0118_merge_20260808_1800.py) was pushed directly to main (outside a PR) by a separate Claude session, joining the two leaf nodes
migration_leaf_node_incident.fix_verified_by_this_task: manage.py check and makemigrations --check --dry-run both clean on the resulting main tip
